rich2021Activities: Original IM2021 G5 U08:L13 challenges fraction multiplication comparison through spinner-generated factor fractions; pupils apply reciprocal relationships and magnitude reasoning when placing digits, comparing first GREATER then SMALLER product.
Warm-up Number Talk Multiply One Third original1/3×3=1,1/3×4=4/3,1/3×6/3=2/3,1/3×1/4=1/12. Students explain partial quantities of a unit whole.

Activity1 Fraction Multiplication Compare: two partners spin a number, put it in one of four numerator/denominator slots, cannot erase, repeat until all four filled and compare resulting products. In the FIRST game largest product wins; in SECOND smallest product wins. Spinner results are not known in advance.

Original printed end-of-section synthesis with digits1,3,5,6 identifies largest product (6/3)×(5/1)=10; smallest SUM1/5+3/6=7/10; smallest DIFFERENCE3/6−1/5=3/10, under the given-digit constraints. These examples clarify strategy but are not falsely substituted for live game outcomes.
